metadata.description: Agent Skills for building Jellycube-compatible Astro templates and sites, and for integrating apps with Jellycube.

plugins.name: jellycube-template
plugins.description: Build or check an Astro project so it imports, edits, serves and publishes correctly in Jellycube, as a stand-alone site or a host-app template.

plugins.name: jellycube-integration
plugins.description: Integrate an app with Jellycube (the Host SDK): host app setup, server handler and sign-in, embedded editor, sites, webhooks, host collections, freshness, islands, theme, previews and own domain, with troubleshooting and a host checker.
